newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-LOLA BOSS HINTS AT GRAND PRIX RETURN.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-LOLA BOSS HINTS AT GRAND PRIX RETURN.

text.p: Lola could return to Formula One just weeks after withdrawing from the world championship.
The British team pulled out before last month's Brazilian Grand Prix, but may be set for a comeback in time for the San Marino Grand Prix at Imola on April 27.
Lola boss Eric Broadley said on Tuesday he was hoping to secure a deal which would enable his cars to re-appear.
The team quit after their Ford-powered cars, driven by Italian Vincenzo Sospiri and Brazilian Ricardo Rosset, failed to qualify for the season-opening Australian Grand Prix.
"I don't want to comment much on it," said Broadley. "You know how these things can fall down around your ears if you are not careful.
"All I will say is that we are working with both drivers with the object of racing at Imola and things are looking good. Beyond that, it is a firm no comment."
Broadley also denied that the Lola company were on the brink of financial collapse. "The company has taken a bit of a hit but there are no problems. I am unconcerned about the situation," he said.
